notes: ἐγένετο κλαυθμός → 'wept' is read as rule 73's collapsed pair, source head on the noun carrying the lexical content; πάντων then carries the English subject 'they all'.
τόν before τράχηλον is emptied by the prenominal possessive 'Paul's' (rules 20, 57), and τοῦ before Παύλου is unrepresented under rule 23.
